item.title: 🇺🇸 🚨 FBI AND SECRET SERVICE: FORTIBLEED CAMPAIGN STILL HITTING FORTINET FIREWALLS AND VPNS A joint FBI and U.S. Secret Service cybersecurity ...
item.description:
🇺🇸 🚨 FBI AND SECRET SERVICE: FORTIBLEED CAMPAIGN STILL HITTING FORTINET FIREWALLS AND VPNS

A joint FBI and U.S. Secret Service cybersecurity advisory published Oct 6 says FortiBleed, a global credential-compromise campaign against internet-facing Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways, is still active.

• Attackers keep scanning exposed FortiGate devices with previously stolen credentials, using credential stuffing, password spraying and GPU cracking of dumped password hashes
• The campaign exploits reused or leaked credentials and legacy SHA-256 password storage
• Once in, they create new admin accounts for persistence; some victims are locked out when original accounts are deleted or their passwords changed
• Reporting cited by the agencies indicates initial access brokers using the attack chain have passed access to INC/Lynx and Payload ransomware affiliates

Recommended mitigations:
• Restrict external management (trusted hosts, then local-in policy) or remove internet admin altogether
• Terminate all admin and VPN sessions; reset all Fortinet VPN and admin passwords
• Enforce phishing-resistant MFA on all remote access and admin accounts
• Review firewall/VPN users and config for unauthorized changes and unrecognized accounts
• Review firewall, VPN, authentication and domain controller logs for lateral movement
• Store admin credentials with PBKDF2 and remove legacy hashes (FortiOS 7.2.11+)
• Review REST API keys, remove unknown ones and refresh the rest

⚠️ Analyst Note:

The advisory describes credential abuse and names no CVE, so patching alone is not enough: the agencies warn lockouts can need remediation beyond standard patching and password resets. It lists attacker IPs and rogue account names to hunt for, but asks defenders to vet those IOCs before blocking, as some addresses may since have been reassigned.

Source:
https://www.ic3.gov/CSA/2026/261006.pdf

item.title: VIDEO | Mathura: Four students die after toxic gas exposure while cleaning a submersible tank at a Gurukul in Vrindavan. District Magistrate Chandra P...
item.description:
VIDEO | Mathura: Four students die after toxic gas exposure while cleaning a submersible tank at a Gurukul in Vrindavan. District Magistrate Chandra Prakash Singh says, "An incident took place at Maharishi Panini Gurukul, a school in Chaitanya Vihar in Vrindavan where children study. There was a nearly 12-feet-deep tank with a submersible pump, and as there was a foul smell coming from it, the children went inside to fix it. Five children from the Gurukul entered the tank, which apparently contained poisonous gas, resulting in the untimely deaths of four children...The untimely deaths of these four children are extremely unfortunate. The Hon'ble Chief Minister has taken immediate cognisance of the incident. One child is completely healthy and survived. It is a very tragic incident and an investigation will be conducted. All possible assistance will also be provided to the affected families."

Mathura SSP Shlok Kumar says, "...There is a water tank inside the institution, which was emitting a foul smell, and the children went inside to clean it. First, one boy entered the tank but did not come out. Four more boys then entered after him. When they also did not come out, the people present there made efforts and somehow brought them out. They were taken to the hospital for treatment, where four of the five children who entered the tank died. They were aged between 17 and 20 years. Their families are being contacted and informed."

item.title: 🇺🇸 🚨 BYOD RANSOMWARE GANG LEAKS DATA ON 3,615 TRUMP MOBILE CUSTOMERS BYOD, a new ransomware-as-a-service operation, has posted data it says b...
item.description:
🇺🇸 🚨 BYOD RANSOMWARE GANG LEAKS DATA ON 3,615 TRUMP MOBILE CUSTOMERS

BYOD, a new ransomware-as-a-service operation, has posted data it says belongs to 3,615 Trump Mobile customers on its leak site. Trump Mobile is only the third victim listed there.

• Straight Arrow News, which first reported the leak, says the data includes names, email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses and order details, and some people listed confirmed their details were accurate
• One customer told SAN he paid a $100 deposit for the T1 phone and never received it
• SAN found no Trump family members in the data
• BYOD claims it infected a Liberty Mobile employee with an infostealer, reached Trump Mobile through that MVNO, that neither firm used MFA, and that it still has backend access
• BYOD says Trump Mobile replied "We have no team to handle this"

⚠️ Analyst Note:

SAN's checks support that real customer data was exposed, but BYOD's claims about initial access, missing MFA and ongoing access are unverified. Trump Mobile, the Trump Organization and Liberty Mobile had not responded to SAN or The Register. BYOD is a different group from EndZone, which listed Trump Mobile on Sep 23, but researcher Dominic Alvieri says both leaks appear to stem from the same original breach. People in the data should expect targeted phishing and SIM-swap attempts.

Sources:
https://san.com/cc/trump-mobiles-latest-problem-hackers-just-released-customer-information/
https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/10/06/trump-mobile-customers-data-dumped-and-some-never-even-received-their-gold-device/5301433

Patchstack reports an active campaign abusing two stored XSS bugs in unrelated WordPress plugins, both delivering the same JavaScript payload from imgcdn1[.]com.

• CVE-2026-93836: WPC Product Bundles for WooCommerce ≤ 8.6.6 (30K+ installs), fixed in 8.6.7
• Both rated CVSS 7.1; the payload is injected without login and fires when an admin views the poisoned submission or order
• It installs a fake "WP Smart Thumbnails" plugin, creates a visible admin plus one hidden from the Users screen, adds a secret login URL and an unauthenticated file manager
• First seen Oct 4 (WPC) and Oct 5 (Ninja Forms)

⚠️ Analyst Note:

Patchstack says exploitation is limited so far, and neither CVE is in CISA KEV at handoff. Updating stops new infections but does not remove an existing one: check for unknown admins, must-use plugins and the fake thumbnail plugin.

item.description:
🇮🇶 🚨 IRAN-LINKED HACKERS POSE AS DUBAI AIRPORTS RECRUITERS TO TARGET IRAQI CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE

Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 says an Iranian state-aligned cluster it tracks as CL-STA-1178 ran a campaign dubbed "Blinder Tunnel" against a target in Iraq's critical infrastructure sector, likely a software engineer.

• Lure: fake Dubai Airports IT recruiters, an offline "careers portal" with an HR questionnaire, then a Visual Studio coding test
• The weaponized project file runs malware the moment the project is opened in the IDE, before any build
• Chain: .csproj abuse → AppDomainManager hijacking (ETW disabled) → DLL sideloading → ShelbyLoader V2
• GitHub API used for C2 with GitHub Issues as fallback; ShelbyC2 V2 backdoor plus "Blackwood", a Chisel wrapper for reverse SOCKS tunneling
• Peaky Blinders-themed infrastructure, staged from Nov 2025 and activated in March 2026; GitHub has taken it down
• Same actor linked to credential harvesting against an Israeli entity in May–June 2026

⚠️ Analyst Note:

Unit 42 says it is not aware of any breach or compromise of Dubai Airports systems; the brand was only impersonated as a lure. Attribution to an Iranian-nexus actor is high confidence, but overlaps with named groups such as Screening Serpens and Agent Serpens are low confidence only. Treat take-home coding tests from unsolicited "recruiters" as untrusted code.

🇲🇾 🚨 MALAYSIA: PENANG PRIMARY SCHOOL SK BUKIT GELUGOR DATABASE ALLEGEDLY LEAKED

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be releasing a database allegedly belonging to SK Bukit Gelugor, a government national primary school in Penang, Malaysia, with more than 750 students and 50 teachers.

The listing claims the data includes:
* Student records
* Staff and teacher information
* Other personal records from the school's systems

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The post is labelled "V1", hides the download behind a reply wall and shows no sample data, so the size and authenticity of the dataset cannot be assessed. The actor's account is new and has only a handful of posts.

This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a compromise of SK Bukit Gelugor or Ministry of Education systems.

If genuine, the leak would involve children's personal data, which carries elevated risk of identity misuse and targeted scams against parents. Parents and staff should be wary of unexpected messages that reference school details.

item.description:
🇮🇳 INDIA: TELEFORCE CLOUD TELEPHONY OPERATOR GARUDA ADVERTISING DOCUMENTS ALLEGEDLY LEAKED

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked a business folder allegedly belonging to Garuda Advertising Pvt. Ltd., the Gurgaon-based company behind the Teleforce cloud telephony, contact-centre and ad-tech platform.

The post describes about 140 documents, including:
* 106 sales proposals and pitch decks
* About 1,070 proforma invoices (March 2025 to October 2026)
* A June 2026 response to an insurer's RFP for a dialer and AI contact-centre solution
* Service agreements, a vendor KYC form, price lists and quotations

The actor says the files expose the company's bank details, two directors' names and home addresses, names, addresses and GST numbers of about 1,000 customers, company tax and registration IDs, and negotiated prices and bid details.

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The post is unusually specific about file counts and date ranges, which suggests the actor had real access to a document set, but no sample files are shown on the page. The data is mostly commercial rather than mass consumer PII.

This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a compromise of Garuda Advertising or Teleforce systems.

If genuine, invoice and bank details enable convincing invoice-fraud and payment-diversion emails to Teleforce customers, and leaked pricing and bids hand rivals a commercial edge.

item.description:
🇻🇪 VENEZUELA: BETTING WEBSITE "ROYALE" USER DATA ALLEGEDLY LEAKED BY TERROAHGROUP

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked part of a database allegedly belonging to "Royale", a betting website with a presence in Latin America (reported as Apuestas Royal).

The post claims the data includes:
* Emails
* Passwords
* ID numbers
* Phone numbers

The actor says this is "just the first part" and that the rest is in the possession of TerroahGroup. A short sample of email:password lines and phone numbers was posted as proof (redacted here).

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The visible sample is small and the post gives no total record count or file size. The phone numbers in the sample use Venezuelan mobile prefixes, which fits a Venezuela-facing betting site, but the operator is not named beyond "Royale". TerroahGroup has recently made other claims against Venezuelan targets.

This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a compromise of the betting operator.

If genuine, users who reuse the same password elsewhere face credential-stuffing risk, and phone numbers plus ID numbers could fuel betting- and payment-themed fraud.

item.title: RT Rajnath Singh: Today is a historic day for HAL Koraput. The Division has today delivered its 2000th engine. This is more than a production mileston...
item.description:
RT Rajnath Singh
Today is a historic day for HAL Koraput. The Division has today delivered its 2000th engine.
This is more than a production milestone. It is a symbol of six decades of engineering capability, skilled manpower and commitment to strengthening India’s defence preparedness. I am extremely pleased to be part of this remarkable journey.
 
HAL Koraput has also crossed another significant milestone. It has overhauled more than 9,000 engines. Behind these numbers is the skill and dedication of the engineers and technicians who keep India’s critical platforms mission-ready.

The production of AL-31FP engines for the Su-30MKI is an important step in strengthening India’s indigenous engine manufacturing capability.

Despite global supply-chain disruptions and raw-material challenges, the Koraput team delivered its first engine ahead of schedule. 63 engines have now been delivered. I would like to acknowledge the commitment demonstrated by the team here in its production.

HAL is also enhancing annual production capacity from 30 to 50 engines. These capabilities directly contribute to the sustained operational readiness of the IAF’s Su-30MKI fleet.
 
India’s growing fleet of indigenous helicopters requires a strong and reliable indigenous engine ecosystem. HAL is establishing a second production line for Shakti engines at Koraput, adding to the existing capability at Engine Division, Bengaluru.

Together, these facilities will strengthen our capacity to support platforms such as the ALH and LCH and meet the evolving requirements of the Armed Forces.
A stronger engine ecosystem is essential to a stronger self-reliant defence capability.
 
Aatmanirbharta in aerospace begins with the materials and technologies that go into an engine. I am pleased to note the progress made in indigenising raw materials for high-thrust engines. 264 lines of raw material have been developed by MIDHANI and received by HAL Koraput. This is an important contribution towards building a domestic ecosystem for advanced aero-engine manufacturing.

Our objective remains clear, that is to develop critical capabilities within India, build the industrial ecosystem around them and progressively reduce dependence on external sources.
